properties.name: Basin Connect North
properties.units: Beaver Marsh CDP; Chemult CDP; Crescent CDP; Gilchrist CDP; La Pine city; Bend city
properties.note: Operator's own site does not list towns, but Herald and News coverage (heraldandnews.com, 'Basin Transit Services announces new Basin Connect North program') and Transit App's published route (transitapp.com Basin Connect North) confirm stops at Beaver Marsh, Chemult, Crescent, Gilchrist, La Pine, and Bend, spanning North Klamath County into Deschutes County.

properties.name: CET Rural Dial-A-Ride
properties.units: Prineville city; La Pine city; Madras city; Redmond city; Sisters city; Warm Springs CDP; Deschutes River Woods CDP
properties.note: Seven towns/places across Central Oregon; Deschutes River Woods pilot zone added May 2026

properties.name: CoosGO
properties.units: buffer 3.39 km @ 43.1200,-124.4100; clipped to Bandon city
properties.note: 14-sq-mi service zone centered on Bandon (Bullards Beach State Park to Beach Loop Road); riders outside zone connected to fixed routes

properties.name: SPOT Southwest
properties.note: Service limited to South Cooper Mountain, River Terrace, Murrayhill, and Progress Ridge neighborhoods in Washington County; full county boundary shown for reference

properties.name: Sunset Empire Transportation District Microtransit Pilot
properties.note: Pilot program ended as of Feb 2026; service area was within Route 20 service zone covering Seaside and Cannon Beach in Clatsop County

properties.name: TriMet NEXT
properties.note: Service limited to South Gresham and Powell Valley neighborhoods within city limits; full city boundary shown for reference

properties.name: UPTD Dial-A-Ride
properties.note: Countywide service across Douglas County, but excludes ADA Paratransit service zone (open to general public with priority to seniors and people with disabilities)
